exercises.title: 7. Czarnikow context: fill in the blanks

items.prompt: In a ___ negotiation, every word is recorded and remembered.
An ___ style, full of threats and ultimatums, rarely works with British partners.
If he had been less ___, banging the table, they would have trusted him more.
A ___ pause before answering signals that you are taking the offer seriously.
Polite ___ on price would have protected our margin.
___ costs nothing and keeps the door open for the next deal.
Had we ___ their offer more gracefully, they might have come back.
items.hintAfterError: Inversão com 'Had' no lugar de 'If we had': depois vem o particípio passado.

items.prompt: When a British partner says 'we'll pass', treat it as a ___.
